name: directive_functions_of_unknown_names
query: SELECT DISTINCT open_date('Assets:Nope') AS opened, close_date('Assets:Nope') AS closed, open_meta('Assets:Nope', 'x') AS meta, commodity_meta('NOPE', 'name') AS commodity, open_date('assets:us:bofa:checking') AS lower_case WHERE account = 'Expenses:Financial:Fees'
notes: An unknown account or commodity is NULL; names are case-sensitive.
